message: Metalama could not write the crash report of an unexpected exception. {0}
rationale: The value passed by CompileTimeExceptionHandler.TryWriteLocalReport already starts with 'Cannot write the crash report to ...', so the rendered message repeats itself ('could not write the crash report file: Cannot write the crash report to ...'). The message also does not say that the report belongs to an unexpected exception (LAMA0001 or LAMA0049) reported at the same time.
codeChange: In CompileTimeExceptionHandler.TryWriteLocalReport (Metalama.Framework.Engine/Pipeline/CompileTime/CompileTimeExceptionHandler.cs, catch block), set errorMessage to $"The path of the file is '{file}'. {e.Message}" instead of $"Cannot write the crash report to '{file}': {e.Message}". The rendered text then becomes: Metalama could not write the crash report of an unexpected exception. The path of the file is '<path>'. <reason of the I/O failure>
